headers.comment: Matches ** rather than **/*.html because cleanUrls serves pages as /login and /profile, with no .html in the request path. An *.html glob never fires for those, which silently disabled every header below. Default is no-cache: there is no build step and no content hashing in filenames, so any real max-age means a deploy does not reach users until their cache expires.
Images are content-stable, so they may be cached properly.
